## Description

Summarize the change and why it's needed. If it closes an issue, [link the issue with a closing keyword](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/linking-a-pull-request-to-an-issue#linking-a-pull-request-to-an-issue-using-a-keyword).

## Checklist

- [ ] The title is descriptive and summarises the new changes
- [ ] The code and any comments are consistent with the current code style
- [ ] For a new or changed OSC address, I documented it in [docs/osc-api.md](https://github.com/eladefrati/ableton-live-test-harness/blob/main/docs/osc-api.md)
- [ ] I ran `node --test harness/tests/*.test.js` and the checks [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/eladefrati/ableton-live-test-harness/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) asks for the files I changed
